info.name: Ads API
info.description:
Ad CRUD endpoints.

Base URL variable: {{url}}
All endpoints are under: {{url}}/api/v1/client/ads

Auth: Bearer {{user_token}} — set both variables in the Collection > Variables tab.

──────────────────────────────────────
FLOW
──────────────────────────────────────
1. POST /ads          → Step 1: Initiate (calls NHC, creates DRAFT ad, returns nhc_data)
2. POST /ads/{id}     → Steps 2-3-4: Update draft with user fields + media → publishes ad
3. GET  /ads          → List my ads (paginated)
4. GET  /ads/{id}     → Show single ad
5. DELETE /ads/{id}   → Delete ad

──────────────────────────────────────
NHC DATA FIELDS (returned inside nhc_data)
──────────────────────────────────────
is_valid, advertiser_id, ad_license_number, advertiser_name,
phone_number, brokerage_and_marketing_license_number, deed_number,
property_price, property_type, property_age, advertisement_type,
property_face, property_usages[], property_area, street_width,
number_of_rooms, plan_number, land_number,
guarantees_and_their_duration, obligations_on_the_property,
ownership_transfer_fee_type, location_description_on_moj_deed,
property_utilities[], responsible_employee_name,
responsible_employee_phone_number, region, city, district,
latitude, longitude, ad_license_url, creation_date, end_date

request.description:
Returns a single ad owned by the authenticated user.

404 if the ad does not exist or belongs to another user.

formdata.description: REQUIRED — FAL (Real Estate Authority) license number. Digits only, 6–12 digits. Saved to user profile on first use.
REQUIRED — Mobile number registered with the Real Estate Authority. Exactly 10 digits, must start with 05. Saved to user profile on first use.

REQUIRED — One of: broker | appraiser | property_manager | investor | developer

For broker / appraiser / property_manager: no commercial registration needed.
For investor / developer: commercial_registration_number and commercial_registration_file become required.
REQUIRED — Per-ad advertisement license number. Digits only, 6–12 digits. Must be unique across the entire platform. 422 returned if already used.

request.description:
Step 1 — Initiates ad creation.

What happens server-side:
1. Validates ad_license_number is not already used (422 if duplicate)
2. Saves fal_license_number, nhc_mobile, advertiser_type to user profile (only if not already set)
3. Calls NHC API (mock) with ad_license_number → receives property data
4. Creates ad in DRAFT status with nhc_data JSON column populated
5. Returns the new ad including full nhc_data

HTTP 201 on success.
HTTP 422 if ad_license_number already exists.

item.name: Step 1 – Initiate Ad (investor / developer — requires commercial registration)

formdata.description: REQUIRED — FAL license number. Digits only, 6–12 digits.
REQUIRED — Mobile registered with Real Estate Authority. 10 digits, starts with 05.
REQUIRED — Use developer or investor to trigger commercial registration requirement.
REQUIRED when advertiser_type is developer or investor. Saved to user profile on first use.
REQUIRED when advertiser_type is developer or investor. Accepted formats: jpg, jpeg, png, pdf. Max size: 5 MB. Stored in user media collection.
REQUIRED — Per-ad advertisement license number. Digits only, 6–12 digits. Unique across platform.

request.description:
Step 1 — Same flow as the broker variant but advertiser_type = developer or investor.

Additionally:
- commercial_registration_number is saved to user profile
- commercial_registration_file is uploaded to the user's media collection (single file, replaces previous)

HTTP 201 on success.

request.description:
Steps 2, 3 & 4 — Updates the DRAFT ad created in Step 1 with all remaining user-provided fields and media.

Send as POST with _method=PUT (required for multipart file uploads in Laravel).

For purpose = sale:
  - deed_number is REQUIRED
  - do NOT send rental_period

HTTP 200 on success. Returns the full updated AdResource.
HTTP 404 if ad not found or not owned by authenticated user.
